APPROVE

`BuildPlan` is now a single `foreach` with a short `if`/`else if`, far under 15. The extracted helpers keep the original Create/Apply conditions, parameter-index precedence and `returnsDocument` handling, so behaviour is unchanged. The `out var` indexes are definitely assigned inside the `&&`-guarded branch, so it should compile. I only read the diff and did not build it, so a StyleCop member-ordering rule (e.g. SA1201 for the const declared between methods) is the one thing I can't rule out.
